summary: A view controller with load_view, view_did_load and view_did_layout hooks sits in the responder chain; navigation stacks, toolbars, alerts, sheets, split views and popover placement exist as models. Presentation controllers with detents, container controllers for tabs and pages, search controllers, pickers and activity sheets are missing or only exist inside the shell.
rea_evidence: not captured: tools/parity/rea-page.sh reported 'no CDP browser on 127.0.0.1:9333 (run: tools/parity/rea-page.sh --start)'; facts are from tools/parity/docc.py

features.note: ViewController::load_view, view_did_load, view_did_layout; no appear and disappear callbacks, no child controller containment, no trait change callback
push and pop through NavigationStack and sheet models; no general present and dismiss with a transition coordinator and no segues, by design

NavigationStack with back titles and a value path (NavigationPath); no navigation bar view with large titles, no interactive back swipe from the leading edge (needs the edge pan in uikit-touches-gestures)
two-pane split with draggable divider, minimums and collapse; no three-column style, no compact collapse onto a navigation stack, no display mode toggle button
no tab container. Needed as the default top-level navigation of tablet apps; build as a ViewController with a bottom tab bar view and a sidebar adaptive mode
horizontal paging with rubber band and velocity snap exists for the home screen only; not an SDK container
a sheet hangs from a window title bar, dims and blocks the parent, with default and cancel keys; no bottom sheet with detents and drag-to-resize, no form sheet or page sheet sizes for touch
place_popover picks an edge, flips when it does not fit and stays on screen; popover drawing with an arrow exists. Not a presentation controller: the app positions it by hand
Alert with default and cancel actions and styles; no text fields in alerts and no action sheet style anchored to a source view
field model only; no results container, no suggestions list presentation
photo library access for apps; no picker view controller, no capture UI in the SDK
Ctx::open_panel, save_document and grants through the file portal; document model with edited state. No in-app document browser and no launch screen for documents
ask the shell for the share menu under a rect; items travel as typed providers. No custom activity types published by apps
font and colour panel models with change callbacks; drawn by the shell for the desktop, no touch layouts
app-level state saving; no per-controller restoration identifiers
fade, move in, push and reveal as a model; no interactive (finger-driven) transitions
layout derives from window size, so portrait and landscape follow from width and height; no explicit query

gaps: Tab bar controller with sidebar adaptation
Interactive back swipe and finger-driven transitions
Collapsing split view onto a navigation stack in compact width
Presentation controller for popovers anchored to a source view
Child view controller containment and appear callbacks
